title: Marvel's Spider-Man Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "You are a sickness on this city. I am the cure!"
"This batch of web fluid will just have to wait!"
"Time to swing into action!"
"You're a month late again, Parker! Give me my money or you're out on the street!"
"Have no fear. Spidey is here!"
... there must also come great responsibility!
"Peter? Is that you? I could have sworn I heard that boy moving around up here." —Aunt May
"Well, I always wanted a waterfront view." —Spider-Man
"I'm the real Spider-Man!" "No, *I'm* the real Spider-Man!"
A skilled showman, Quentin Beck incorporated lights, special effects, holography . . . all in the service of a . . . DRAMATIC . . . ENTRANCE!
"My spider-sense—it's tingling! Something behind me!"
Wounded in action, Corporal Thompson was offered an experimental way to be all he could be.
"Open your eyes to your nightmare, Spider-Man." —Doctor Octopus, Otto Octavius
"Spider-Man, I'm truly sorry for all the bad luck you've been having."
"I've got the nose for the story. He's got the hunger for the kill. Together..."
"... we are Venom!"
The Inheritors stalk the Spiders across worlds, feeding on their life force for sustenance.
"Things have gotta go my way eventually, right?"
"You fool! You thought you had won?"
"Spiders don't hold still given any other choice, and I have all the choices in the Multiverse!"
"The photos are garbage, Parker! I'll buy them all."
"It's time, Harry. Take the mask and avenge me."
"Disrespect authority. Smash the system."
Every Spider ever...and then some!
Dr. Curt Connors used lizard DNA to regrow his missing arm, but it didn't stop there.
"You can't call yourself Spider-Man without taking a leap of faith. It's a lot to live up to. But I'm creating an all-new legacy."
"Ow! A spider! It bit me! But why is it glowing that way?" —Peter Parker
And then—as the agonizing ache in his limbs seems unendurable—from out of the pain—from out of the agony—comes triumph!
"We love you, Spider-Man!"
The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.
"Soon all will cower before the superior intellect of Doctor Octopus!"
For Professor Miles Warren, all any problem needs is a lot of clones and not a lot of ethics.
"I have found honor, not in the civilized, but in the primal."
Charismatic and confident, Mary Jane was born for the limelight.
"Light and dark. They are in opposition, but both are necessary. I am both, and so I am all."
To know her is to fear her.
Dr. Johnathon Ohnn had no problem breaking laws, physical or otherwise.
"I will be Spider-Man. With my unparalleled genius, I shall become the *Superior* Spider-Man." —Otto Octavius
Osborn's lust for power was nothing short of monstrous.
Once powerful tools of science, Dr. Otto Octavius's mechanical arms became his most formidable weapons.
The device crackled to life, the portal opened, and Gwen's allies across the Great Web poured forth.
Peter appreciated the powerful new suit sent by Tony Stark, but he soon found it came with some strings attached.
"How does Parker get those close-ups?" —J. Jonah Jameson
New worlds await...
For Peter, apartment hunting was about location, location, cost, and location.
